breaking.member: og style art, og style pack and style cooking
breaking.change: The cook no longer recolours part slices or injects their measured tones. og style art packs only corner, divider, flourish, crest and edge ornaments; it reports other requests as skipped. For version 2+ styles, og style pack no longer writes part dressing blocks. Style summaries no longer count dressings.
breaking.fix: Author part appearance in standard CSS. Ornament packing and recolouring remain available until the style.ogt pack format is replaced by CSS tooling.
